name: Chakana
description: Andean stepped crosses, three steps to every side and a round hole at the heart, their arms joining into a lattice with stepped diamonds of ground between.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--chakana); clip-path: @var(--chakana); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 22%, #000 22%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 22%, #000 22%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 25%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--chakana); clip-path: @var(--chakana); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 44%, #000 44%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 44%, #000 44%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
